snippet.title: TooneQuest 5 Minutes of Gameplay
snippet.description:
This 5 minutes of extended gameplay in 4 areas of the game was created for theIndiePremier.com.

You see the player exploring a few areas and capturing Toones they find and collecting Food as they find it.
